question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Are you going to Prom this year?
options: Prom? That's such a high school thing.

question_options.question: Which couple would you be most interested in seeing together?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, from the polling research I collected when I was running for President, I know that people like to feel special.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: When I make general promises about what I want to do in office, fewer people respond to me.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But when I'm specific about what I'm offering to every one, they're more likely to vote for me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But what does that mean for me?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: In your case, asking all the girls at once won't work because girls like to feel special.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: They want guys to ask them for a specific reason, not just because they want someone to go with...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I suggest picking one girl and sticking with her.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I've asked every single girl in Centerscore. What should I do now?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It seems to me like your reputation is shot, and believe me, reputation is everything. If your rep is good, it's easier to get what you want.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Popular support... The presidency... Girls...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But if everyone sees you as desperate... Your rep isn't so good.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What can I do?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, unless you help depose an evil principal threatening to take over the school, there's not much you can do.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Building up good reputation is something that takes a lot of energy and time.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Time is the only thing I don't have.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I won't get a date if none of the girls at Centerscore want to go with me!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You don't have to take a girl from Centerscore.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If your name here is ruined, you can always go to a different school.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can't go with a girl from Wilson. They're scary.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I didn't say 'Wilson'.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Where else? It's not like there's a school full of girls just waiting to be asked, is there?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Actually...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My mission is to secure a date, and I'm determined to do that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Even if it means asking every girl in this neighborhood!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I can admire that kind of blind ambition...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But be that as it may, you still come across as 'desperate'.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh. What's not working about my approach?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And if you fail, you try again, right?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...Right?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Erik, but the more rejections you collect, the more of a loser you seem.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Even `I` feel sorry for you now...
nodes.text_bbcode: Even [i]I[/i] feel sorry for you now...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh. What's not working about my approach?
Erik skips away.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Any luck?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nope! Still no date...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I think I made some new friends!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You know, the nerds and I are going to be gaming on Prom night if you want to join us.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, but no thanks, Dex. I've started this mission. I'm going to see it through.
Erik walks away dejectedly.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No luck?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No one wants to go to the dance with me. And whatever I said seemed to make them really mad.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Welcome to the ways of the world... Are you ready to give up? You know, the nerds and I are going to be gaming that night if you want to join us.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No... I've started this mission. I'm seeing it through.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What are you going to do now?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Keep on trying! It's a numbers game, right?
And for the next few days, Erik collects rejections...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Are you kidding, freak? If we danced, I'd crush you alive!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You're asking me? That's creepy! I don't date nerds.
One after another...

nodes.speaker: Ashley
nodes.text: Look, Erik, that's really sweet... But we just don't have any chemistry...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm not really interested in seeing anyone right now.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sorry, kid. I already have a date.
Until Erik runs out of girls!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've run out of girls! I even asked ones that weren't on the list!
Erik is walking with his head down, when he suddenly runs into Justin!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik! Don't look down!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, Justin! You know I was feeling a little defeated, but now that you said that, I feel a little better!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I meant, you shouldn't walk with your head down. You almost hit me.
Justin starts to walk away.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait, Justin, could I ask you something?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: If you make it quick.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I've been trying to find a date to Prom, but I'm not having any luck.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik, you might be having problems because everyone thinks you're desperate.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not desperate, I'm...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's cool that you'd give up so much to win.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't regret it. But it is a lot of work.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And it's not `all` about the winning, but it is my dream to make it to the top.
nodes.text_bbcode: And it's not [i]all[/i] about the winning, but it is my dream to make it to the top.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No chance you'd want to take a break to dance and drink punch?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Ha ha. No. I go to bed early. But I hope you find someone.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And word of advice? Don't ask girls out in a row like that. It makes you seem a little creepy, which is a shame because you seem nice.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry? What are you sorry for? You don't have to feel sorry for me. I `love` swimming.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sorry? What are you sorry for? You don't have to feel sorry for me. I [i]love[/i] swimming.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I didn't meant to offend you! I'm sorry!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Again with the 'sorry'. I'm the one that chose this life. It's intense and requires a lot from me, but I'm willing to give it everything.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry you'll have to go find someone else.
Erik walks back to the nerd table.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What did she say?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She doesn't believe in going with 'dates'. She'd rather go with a friend than with me.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I told you she was different. Are you going to go back?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There is one last girl...
The boys look over and see Sara eating her lunch and reading a book.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That's Sara. No one knows that much about her. She's very quiet.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But it's the quiet ones that cave!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There's no harm in trying. That's what the Captain from Space 'Splosions always says! And he's gotten his crew out of every mess!
Erik walks back to the table and up to Sara.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, Sara, I was wondering...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You want to ask me to Prom.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How did you know?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Just because I was reading, doesn't mean I wasn't listening. You asked everyone at the table before me, so I figured I'd be next.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'll spare you the trouble. I can't go. I have a strict swimming regimen, and that means I work twice as much on Saturdays as any other day.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I have to stay in good shape for competition. I have a lot of races coming up.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: That's awfully cryptic. Why?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I was just wondering if you were free...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Okay...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's just that, next Friday, there's something going on...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And your `point` is?
nodes.text_bbcode: And your [i]point[/i] is?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Would you go out with me?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Why would you be asking me...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Wait, next Friday is Prom! Are you seriously asking me to Prom?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know it's not really your thing...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You got that right. It isn't my thing.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Which is why I didn't want to mention it.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You could've at least had the courage to ask straight up.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And for your information, I am going to Prom. With my `girl` friends. Now get out of here.
nodes.text_bbcode: And for your information, I am going to Prom. With my [i]girl[/i] friends. Now get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: S... Sure!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You're asking me to Prom? That's cute.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You know, I really appreciate that you asked me.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: People think that just because I like protests and discussions about feminism that I hate things like Prom.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: But I still like to hang out with my friends and go to dances. And everyone should get to go to Prom if they have the chance to.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So you'll go with me?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sorry, Erik, but I'm going with a group of my girl friends. I don't really want to be someone's date, you know?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It just doesn't fit in with my beliefs.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can respect that.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You're a good person. I hope you find someone!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You're a male in the animal world! There are many more females out there! Who's next?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I could ask Jane. She's right next to Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Jane is a tough nut to crack. She likes her independence. The only way you're going to get her to go with you is if you become 'anti'.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: 'Anti'?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You know. Counter-culture. Jane doesn't like being involved with institutions like dances and Prom.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How do you know all this stuff?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I keep a journal. For scientific purposes.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So what do I do for Jane?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: What you think you should do is what you shouldn't do. That's what 'anti' means!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't even know what you just said! But okay!
Erik returns to the table and approaches Jane.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hello, Jane. So I was wondering...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yes?

options.label: What are you doing next Friday?
Do you want to go to Prom?

nodes.text: Erik slips his sunglasses on.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Shades up!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Looks good!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's kind of hard to see in these...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You'll be fine. Make your move! Go!
Erik makes his way over to Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I can barely see anything in this cafeteria!
Erik bumps into a table!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whoa, excuse me!
Erik bumps into a girl's elbow!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Watch it!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think I found her!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why, hello there, swimmer.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You know you're talking to a wall, right?
Erik turns around and tries again.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why, hello there, swimmer. Nice sunny weather we've been having. Thank goodness for these bad-boy sunglasses, am I right?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sure, but isn't is hard to see through those?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Who cares about vision when you look cool?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh, right.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Listen, I was thinking...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Would you like to go to Prom with me?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Uh, no way! I don't date guys who are clumsy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...Oh, sorry.
Erik walks back to his and Dex's table and slides his shades off.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: How'd it go?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The glasses didn't work. I still need a date.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So one didn't work out! That's okay!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Sounds good. Make your move! Go!
Erik walks up to Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hello, swimmer. You're looking nice today.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Aren't you nice? Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I wanted to ask if you had a date to Prom...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And if you didn't, if you would let me take you.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I have a motorcycle with two helmets for safety.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: A motorcycle? I `love` motorcycles!
nodes.text_bbcode: A motorcycle? I [i]love[/i] motorcycles!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I got her to talk to me!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What kind of motorcycle do you have?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... The kind with two wheels.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ha ha. What `brand` is your motorcycle? Is it a Revvin' 6000?
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha. What [i]brand[/i] is your motorcycle? Is it a Revvin' 6000?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Or a teal-toned ToTheMaxx 2500 Custom?
Erik shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh, don't tell me that you have a RipRoarin' 45?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No... I don't have one of those...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, sorry, sweetie. I can't go to Prom with you.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I don't date guys that have cheap motorcycles. I like the expensive ones. They ride real fast and smooth.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: This isn't going to devastate you, is it?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No! I'll be fine.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I just hope you find the motorcycle man of your dreams!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're so sweet. Maybe I'll see you at the dance?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure thing!
Erik walks back to his and Dex's table.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That looks like rejection.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: But, hey, at least you got her talking. You're okay!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I can tell you what I did in my Prom RPG...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I followed the rules of the jungle!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The rules of nature. You know why reptiles and fish lay a lot of eggs?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They like babies?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: For survival! They do it because only a handful of their eggs ever survive to adulthood! Take the same approach here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Where am I going to get all those eggs?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No, no. I mean start asking a lot of girls out! You have to give yourself as many chances as possible.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Dating is basically a numbers game. One of the girls will have to say 'yes'.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: That's not how I ended up dating Dinah...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Perhaps not, but in the interests of time, this is Erik's best strategy.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Do you understand and accept your mission, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's just like the captain of Space 'Splosions says... 'Never turn down a mission you understand!'
It's lunchtime, and Erik is looking over the lunch room.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Find a table. Scope out the prey.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And then I ask them out?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: No! As with everything, you need to plan your approach!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: They're never going to say 'yes' if you don't figure out your 'in'.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My in?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Your courtship display.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: How successful do you think a male bird of paradise is going to be courting a female without a ritual dance?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Or if a bull frog doesn't bother to sing for the girl frog of his dreams?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I suppose if it's trying very hard...

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: The answer is 'not very'!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Now look at that table over there...
Dex points to a table where the swim team is eating.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You want to ask those girls? That's the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They look nice.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: They do, up until they eat you alive. Let's start with Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Hannah loves a guy that's tall, important, and a little bit of a bad boy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not that tall or that important or that much of a bad boy...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I do have shades! Do you think those would help?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Also, Hannah likes guys with motorcycles. You could tell her you have one.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I don't.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Doesn't matter. You're just trying to start a conversation.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So I'll go up to her in my shades and talk about motorcycles?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa, you don't want to overwhelm her. Just choose one. What's your angle?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I suppose it's impractical if you have no friends that are girls.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: But the Student Help Ads would be easy to post on.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't see why it'd be `that` difficult. To ask a girl online, you'd only need a computer and access to her profile...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I don't see why it'd be [i]that[/i] difficult. To ask a girl online, you'd only need a computer and access to her profile...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh, I see the problem.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No real girl friends, no virtual ones either.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: That just makes us sound like we're losers...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Maybe there's another way to do it. Any other ideas?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Those all seem like great ideas, but...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't think I want to ask a girl through an ad in a newspaper or online.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Plus, I have a feeling a girl's more likely to say 'yes' if she can see my face!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: You'd think that, wouldn't you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Keep dreaming, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay, any other ideas?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: But enough about the love of my life. What are you going to do about Prom?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hadn't thought about it...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Time is of the essence! You must go!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I don't have a date.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You must find one and snatch her up! Otherwise, you will be cold, soulless, and alone!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Like the icy arctic breeze that misses the tropical bird of paradise!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't want to be that!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Unless you move quickly, that will be your fate. You must make it your mission!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My mission?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My mission! I must find a girl right away!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: That is the wild spirit!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But, Astrid, what should I do first?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Oh, Erik, I would love to help you catch a wriggling seal of your own, but if I'm to get Howard as a date...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: I have to act now, and seize the day by the hem of its pants!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, I understand...
Astrid kisses Erik on the cheek!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Best luck hunting!
Astrid rushes off.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, `now` who am I going to get love advice from?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [i]now[/i] who am I going to get love advice from?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait! I know just the guys to ask!
An hour later, Ben, Dex, Justin, and Brendan crowd into Erik's small room.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Wow, you have so many DVD box sets!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, they're the original Space 'Splosions DVDs! I have all seven seasons, including the spin-offs!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I should hardly be surprised.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Now why did you call us in, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Guys, I need a date to the Prom! I don't have one yet, and my sister Astrid tells me time is of the essence!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Astrid is your sister? But you are nothing alike.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, I know. She looks like my mom. I look like my dad.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's not the only thing I was thinking...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But this isn't why we're here.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We're here because I want to know what you're doing for Prom. Ben?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: You know, I haven't really thought about it yet. Justin, what about you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't have time for such nonsense. I have administrators to inform, financial forms to fill out, and acts to veto!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: So you couldn't get a date?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I didn't say that!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Dex, what about you?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I have a date... On my computer! I already asked out a girl who has high intelligence, average popularity, and a keen interest in sweets.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Great! Who?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: ItGirl2557. She's one of the players in this Prom RPG I created. It's just like the real thing, except I don't get hives.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh. I see.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: I already have a date.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh! How did you ask her out?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Well, actually, she's my long-term girlfriend... So it was pretty easy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Eep! Long-term? I'm already so far behind! I don't even know where to start!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, who do you want to ask out? What about any of your girl friends? Those are generally good to go with.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: They know who you are, you know you can have a good time together, and you're less afraid to ask them out!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't really have any girl friends.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What about girls you know?
Erik shakes his head.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Here, Erik, I have something that can help.
Dex pulls up a detailed spreadsheet on his laptop.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What's that?

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: For Valentine's Day a couple years ago, Angie created an algorithm that could define love!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I tweaked it for my Prom game so that I could generate a list of partners that players would be most compatible with.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I just need to cross reference that with our school's database and input your information... Name: Erik. Height: 5 feet 5 inches.
After a moment, Dex's laptop chirps.

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: Done! Here's a list.
Awestruck, Erik looks over the list.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's a long list of girls! But how am I going to ask them out?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know someone online who asked their date through email.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Or we could do something through the Student Help Ads! That's how I found my way to Dinah.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Aren't those ideas...

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Ah yes, `her.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ah yes, [i]her.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard loves her the way a killer whale loves a seal...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: To eat?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: No! You are indeed new to love, Erik. Love is about the excitement, the squealings, the thrilling chase!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think I get it...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But if he is in love, doesn't that mean he's not going to Prom with you?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Sad as I am, you are right to bring that up.

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Should I respect their love?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Or aggressively pursue those who the stars have crossed in fate?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: The mere fact he rejected me because he is so loyal to her makes me want him even more!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: He is not avoiding me!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: He merely makes himself scarceful when I am around.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But what about that one time he jumped into the lake when we ran into him at the park?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: You are new to the ways of love, Erik. Howard was feeling the way a hyena feels when it howls over a carcass in the savannas!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hungry?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: No! Love is about the careful stalking, the finding, the thrilling chase!

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Howard ran because he cannot contain himself around me. `That is all.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Howard ran because he cannot contain himself around me. [i]That is all.[/i]

nodes.title: Erik's Date
nodes.subtitle: Can Erik find the right girl?

nodes.text: One Saturday morning, at the Ericson household...
Erik comes downstairs for breakfast.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good morning, Astrid!
Astrid sits at the breakfast table, cutting circles out of pictures of Howard.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Positive thinking. A leopard always envisions the taking of the mountain goat before it starts the chase!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Er... Are you cutting $ZOE out of $ZOE and Howard pictures?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Like I said, positive thinking. This American Promenade is coming up.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Promenade?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Prom? A big dance where the boys drink punches and the girls gyrate to hip music.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is that here already?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Almost! It is merely weeks away!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Who are you going with?

nodes.speaker: Astrid
nodes.text: Isn't it as obvious as the palest moon in the darkest ocean? I am going with Howard!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Isn't Howard...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I asked Prissy first.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: See? Your flirting doesn't work all the time, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I'm sorry you don't have someone to go with, Paige and other girls.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If you need help getting them, I have friends who also need dates!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! He's got you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, we don't need your help, thank you very much.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know why you bothered asking Prissy, though. She's going to say no.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We have something in common! See, my `favorite` TV show is...
nodes.text_bbcode: We have something in common! See, my [i]favorite[/i] TV show is...

nodes.text: Erik runs down a long stretch of grass, the kite lines extending behind him.
A huge gust of wind lifts the kite, sending it upward! The kite soars gracefully through the air!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Watch this!
Erik twists the control lines. The kite does a flip in the air!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And here's another one!
Erik pulls the lines. The kite spins twice and dives downward!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Okay... That was kind of cool...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But how hard is maneuvering a kite?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You want to try?
Erik hands the control lines to Prissy.
Prissy twists the lines! The kite crashes.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: This is dumb.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're just saying that because you crashed it.
Erik sets the kite into the air again and makes it spin.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: That's impossible.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You want to make it do a figure 8?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: ...Sure.
And for some time, Erik teaches Prissy how to maneuver the kite into a figure 8...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay, first, pull a little bit on the right string so it circles...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Then you pull it left, and it should flip!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I've been pulling the left string as gently as I can! What else can I...
With one last tug, the kite does a figure 8!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I did it! I did it! I...
The kite crashes.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, that's wasn't so hard...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's not what you said an hour ago...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She looked really happy there for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, I'm done eating now, and it's getting pretty late. Can we go?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The ship has so many cool weapons! The Undertaking is one of the most decked out ships in the entire sci-fi fantasy universe!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Out of the entire show, your favorite part is the Uteridax Laser Canon 337-U8?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's really cool that you know the name of their primary weapon...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It's just like a boy to enjoy sparkling lights and loud noises.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I told you my favorite thing about the show. What's yours?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You can't have a favorite part if you don't like the show...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But you `must` like the show if you know the name of...
nodes.text_bbcode: But you [i]must[/i] like the show if you know the name of...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Forget it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I like watching the fight scenes, but really, my favorite part is watching the relationships between Captain Quarch and his crew!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Wow, that's why `I` watched the show...
nodes.text_bbcode: Wow, that's why [i]I[/i] watched the show...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I really like that one episode 'Love at First Flight' when ace pilot Novo gets kidnapped on that red edge planet...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He meets this alien...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Aphelia?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah! And they help each other escape from the Bulkonians!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Their romance-turned-friendship was pretty `stellar!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Their romance-turned-friendship was pretty [i]stellar![/i]

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Groan... I can't believe you just said that. You really are lame.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Lame for Space 'Splosions! What's your favorite part?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It might be kind of silly, but I like any episode with the twins.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Lieutenant Auror and Petty Office Boreal?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah. They are a funny brother-sister combination. It reminds me of...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, forget it.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What other characters do you like?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: There's this one part where Novo and Aphelia meet for the second time...
Prissy and Erik discuss their favorite television series...
Until it gets dark...
Erik starts to run down a long stretch of grass...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Any second now... It'll fly straight up!
The kite strings tangle themselves around Erik's feet! Erik trips!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ahhhh!
Erik hits the ground with a large 'thud'. The kite crashes to the ground.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ha ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Somehow, I don't think she's laughing because she's having fun...
Erik tries to stand up but topples over again!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ha ha! This is great!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Maybe you could help me get these strings off?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Not a chance.
And for the next hour, Erik entertains Prissy by untangling his feet.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: At least she smiled...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's fly a kite!
From a backpack, Erik unfolds two brightly colored kites.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Those are kites?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Have you ever flown one of these?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I try to avoid manual labor.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Then you're in for a treat! These are stunt kites! They do tricks!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Tricks?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, I'll show you.
Erik hooks up the kite strings and straightens the control lines.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It's not flying.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It has to catch the wind first... Here, I'll get it up in the air for you...
Erik points to a large tree with thick, low branches.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: No. Way.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just a couple branches? You won't regret it.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I already do.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Come on. You could be like Captain Quarch when he had to climb a tree to escape from the mud people!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It was the `grass` people, and he was climbing in order to reach his spaceship and fly away.
nodes.text_bbcode: It was the [i]grass[/i] people, and he was climbing in order to reach his spaceship and fly away.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: ...Fine. I'll climb. But if my designer jeans rip, you're paying for them!
Prissy climbs a few branches.
After a few moments, they're at the top of the tree!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hoo boy! You can see everything!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: If by `everything`, you mean the tops of more trees.
nodes.text_bbcode: If by [i]everything[/i], you mean the tops of more trees.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And the lake, and you can even see the edge of town! Isn't this cool?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, the wind does get my hair out of my face... And that feels nice.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good!
They sit up and enjoy the view for a few more minutes before scrambling down.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Okay, what now?
Erik points to the large lake.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: No. Way. That water is freezing, and you never told me to bring a bathing suit!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The water's not that cold. And you can just jump in, clothes and all! I used to do that with my dad every summer.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: If you haven't noticed, it's `not` summer.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you haven't noticed, it's [i]not[/i] summer.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It almost is. Come on, you could be Captain Quarch as he swims to save the lives of his crew!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: ...Fine. I'll jump in. But you first!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Jump in together?
They jump in at the same time.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Gahhhh! It... It's `freezing!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Gahhhh! It... It's [i]freezing![/i]

nodes.text: Prissy runs out onto the land, and Erik follows.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: All right. I demand a towel now.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Towel?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: `You didn't bring towels?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]You didn't bring towels?![/i]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It was a spontaneous decision?
And a couple hours later...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Are you still mad?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yes! It took no less than an hour to get water out of my ear, and my clothes are still `damp.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yes! It took no less than an hour to get water out of my ear, and my clothes are still [i]damp.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: At least it's warm outside. It could've been worse.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It could've been better.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Let's try doing something else... I promise, it won't even involve the lake.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It'll be better than sitting around in my `damp` clothes. What do you have in mind?
nodes.text_bbcode: It'll be better than sitting around in my [i]damp[/i] clothes. What do you have in mind?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah! Later. After we do other things...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, right now for instance, we're going to...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Cheap? Cheap?! We've just met, but you must understand that I don't do `cheap.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Cheap? Cheap?! We've just met, but you must understand that I don't do [i]cheap.[/i]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Cheap is for the low class. And I'm higher than that.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: `Much` higher. Don't insult me.
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]Much[/i] higher. Don't insult me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I wasn't trying to. But I like cheap. It's how I save for all the box sets of Space 'Splosions!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And it's how I'm planning on saving money for Prom!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I'm now starting to regret agreeing to this date...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You can't regret it before you've had the picnic!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Picnic? We're going to picnic?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I suppose that most dates `do` take me to a fancy restaurant like Armondo's or The Oceanside Obelisk...
nodes.text_bbcode: I suppose that most dates [i]do[/i] take me to a fancy restaurant like Armondo's or The Oceanside Obelisk...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You're right, this is different. I don't know how I feel about that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: When I get that way, I choose 'happy'!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I guess it's better than the alternative.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You've never come to the park before?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Not without a tent, four layers of sunscreen, mosquito netting, bug spray, and a state-of-the-art luxury trailer with television and shade.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Everyone should be able to enjoy the park. Don't you like doing new things?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Not particularly.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It'll be fun. You can't complain now. We haven't even had the picnic yet!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Picnic? We're going to picnic?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wow, you have the cutest glasses!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hee hee, thanks! They make me see better!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ha ha. I haven't heard a boy giggle before. You're way too cute to be wasting your time on Prissy...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, I don't know if that's true...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, really! You are!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Stop embarrassing yourself, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're just jealous now that he's paying attention to me.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Paige, would you like to go to Prom with me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry, Erik. I already have somebody else in mind.
Erik turns back to Prissy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: So, Prissy...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Really? You're going to ask me again after you asked Paige?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No! I just think it would be fun if `we` went. You and I have more in common... See, my `favorite` TV show is...
nodes.text_bbcode: No! I just think it would be fun if [i]we[/i] went. You and I have more in common... See, my [i]favorite[/i] TV show is...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Hilarious.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So your name is Erik, huh? What `is` your 'mission' here?
nodes.text_bbcode: So your name is Erik, huh? What [i]is[/i] your 'mission' here?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Paige, don't encourage him.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Actually, I'm glad you asked because...
Prissy turns to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It doesn't matter if you're here on a field trip or a scavenger hunt. Do whatever it is you need to, then get out.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: O... Okay. I'm looking for a date for Prom.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And who's the lucky girl?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I wanted to ask Prissy.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I know it's a few weeks away, but if you haven't agreed to go with anyone... Will you go to Prom with me?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: He's joking, right?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't joke when it comes to these things. As Captain Quarch always says: 'There are two things men should always take seriously...'

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: 'Intergalactic alien wars and women'? Come on, quoting Space 'Splosions isn't going to get me to say 'yes'.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know the rest of the line!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I, er... Don't be ridiculous!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's silly... Prissy never watches anything but the Fashion Gossip channel!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Hey! I also like watching the Gossip Gossip channel.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: But, Erik, why are you going after Prissy?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know some of us don't have dates to Prom yet...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Is she offering to go? ...No, wait. Justin told me to focus on one girl, and I chose Prissy.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, Erik. Wouldn't you rather go with someone who's more charming and fun than Prissy?
Prissy blinks.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: What, that didn't even offend you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh, no?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Okay, fine. Let's try this. You're glasses are so outdated, it's laughable.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You think? I like them because they're a little old-fashioned. And they do make me laugh!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: They remind me of the eighties!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: No one sensible this side of the century likes eighties fashion. And by the way, your shoes are dirty!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I like to walk a lot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You're losing your touch, Prissy. You used to be able to make a boy cry with just a look.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It's because this one's an idiot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But isn't it funny that he hasn't left yet?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: That's the best comeback you have?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You wouldn't be the first to tell me that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But he would be the first boy to say it so nicely!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I know! Usually, the boys that Prissy insults just leave right away.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Isn't it funny that this one hasn't?
Wind

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, wow! This school looks like a golf course!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And Justin was right to point me here! There are lots of girls around! Which one do I pick?
Across the lawn, Erik sees a group of Monarch Prep girls.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That looks like a good place to start!
Erik walks across the lawn, overhearing the girls' conversation as he draws closer.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I wish we had a Prom at Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe if my dad adds another wing to the library, we can convince Whitford!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You know how Whitford feels about boys. They're gross.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: What do you care anyway, Paige? It's not like any of us have dates.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I need to identify the leader like Justin said. In Space 'Splosions, the leader is always the scary one with tentacles for eyes!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: `I` have a date! That cute guy from Centerscore just asked me yesterday!
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]I[/i] have a date! That cute guy from Centerscore just asked me yesterday!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: No one cares, Madisenn.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: You're just mad because no one asked `you` to Prom, Prissy.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're just mad because no one asked [i]you[/i] to Prom, Prissy.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Please. Tons of boys asked. I'm just not lame enough to take the first offer.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No tentacles... But that Prissy girl must be the leader! Plus, she doesn't have a date!
Erik walks up to the girls.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hello, prep girls! I'm Erik! I come bearing peace!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What have we here?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Eep! A boy's on campus! Whitford always said we need to be on our guard.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on, this boy's hardly a threat.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: But we might get in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Ugh, let me handle this. You. Boy. Get out of our school.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I plan to! But only after I complete my mission.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: And what's that? To look absolutely trashy? Your shirt looks so cheap.

options.label: Thanks! I got it on sale!

nodes.text: But not a `perfect` one! Play again to win your bonus scene!
nodes.text_bbcode: But not a [b]perfect[/b] one! Play again to win your bonus scene!

nodes.text: See you next time on Surviving High School!
And don't forget to join us on facebook.com/survivinghighschool to tell us what you thought of this episode and discuss SHS with other fans!
Erik walks Prissy out of the park.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It's really cool that you're a Space 'Splosions fan.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: But I didn't figure you'd be into that kind of show.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Yeah well... Sci fi isn't usually my thing, but I used to watch it with my older brother all the time.

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Before he went off to college.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You and your brother were close?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You could say that. He's way older than me, so we can't be `super` close, but...
nodes.text_bbcode: You could say that. He's way older than me, so we can't be [i]super[/i] close, but...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It's more like our parents didn't really spend that much time with us, so we'd hang out all the time.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I used to watch Space 'Splosions to remind me of him when he was away.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's sweet.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah well. Then I grew up, and my mom started making me watch Fashion Runway, and I forgot about all that stuff.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Don't be. Fashion is my life.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm glad you still remember Space 'Splosions, though. Otherwise we wouldn't have gone out today.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You know, this wasn't a completely awful date.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You think so?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I might have had a little fun.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Does this mean you'll come to Prom with me?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Whoa, I'm not promising anything. And if someone better comes along, I'm going with him. But...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Until that happens, sure.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yay!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But no one at Monarch Prep can know I agreed to do this, got it?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `I` won't tell them!
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]I[/i] won't tell them!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Good. Pick me up at eight that evening?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: And you'll be picking me up in a limo and wearing a tux, right?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: And while the picnic was okay, can we do something more like dinner next time?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I was thinking L'Amour or the Oceanside Obelisk...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Something fancy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Er... Sure...
